assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG low-resolution PIXEL ART review concept. Chunky square clusters, dark selective outlines, subdued earth wood linen stone iron palette, restrained three-tone shading. No gradients, smooth painting, photorealism, text, labels, UI, watermark, magic. Focused close LANDMARK inspection view of two neighboring grapevine supports along a PUBLIC DRY FOOTPATH, not entire vineyard. LEFT older gnarled vine rooted IN GROUND, one modest living bud and a clearly dead shriveled branch still attached; no grapes. RIGHT younger rooted vine with a clearly visible wrapped GRAFT JOIN and modest small new shoots, linen tie kept visible around junction. The two root areas remain separate on each side of a short stone divider, path goes around them without trampling. Small dry sample shelf holds a single blank prior-witness tally and old detached spare tying cord, not a pulled vine. Fixed comparison of old source growth, real labor and failure; no uprooting, no person, no future abundant harvest, no ownership transfer, no magical regrowth, no doubled yield. Graft morphology is art proposal, not a horticultural certification.
